target_customer: Makers and operators of small UAVs
problem: Small drones rely on lithium polymer batteries with short flight times and low payload.
business_model: Hardware sales of microengines for UAVs (not confirmed by a source)
product_category: UAV propulsion and power, thermoelectrophotovoltaic microengines

founders.name: Ankita Ghoshal
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page and the named inventor on Reebeez patent filings (Justia). No background found.

founders.name: Prianka Ghoshal
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no background found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Solid-state thermoelectrophotovoltaic power at drone scale is research-grade, and the claim of eight times the specific energy of lithium polymer batteries was unproven.

defensibility.rationale: Patent filings on lightweight thermionic microengines exist, but no working product was shown in sources.

incumbents: Fuel cell makers such as Intelligent Energy
takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Longer-endurance drone power developed via fuel cells and academic work, for example a UC Berkeley thermophotovoltaic result reported in 2019.

market_need_then: The YC description says drone endurance and payload are limited by lithium polymer batteries. No sized demand data was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material found beyond the YC listing.

outcome_analysis: Reebeez pitched a research-grade microengine for drones with a two-person team and left almost no public trace beyond patent filings and the YC listing. The cause of inactivity is not public, funding is unknown, and failure factors stay empty because no source explains the outcome.
notes: Website reebeez.co returned 503. No funding amounts found; Crunchbase snippet shows only placeholder milestones. A loot-drop profile describes Reebeez as a consumer drone maker, which conflicts with the YC description and is treated as unreliable. Competitor search returned no source dated near 2016 for rivals, so the list is empty. Branding search found nothing.
